Notice of Adverse Determination - Medical Necessity

Date of Notice: [[LETTER_DATE]]

Member ID: MBR535378523

Service Reviewed: Inpatient admission for community-acquired pneumonia, DRG 195
Dates of Service: [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]]
Criteria Set Applied: MCG-style criteria, current published version in effect on the date of admission

DETERMINATION

Northgate Advantage has completed medical necessity review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the clinical information submitted by the facility and the criteria set applied, this is an adverse determination, medical necessity. The requested inpatient level of care is not certified for the dates of service listed.

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

The following criteria were reviewed and found not met:

PNA-02 - Not met. Finding: The patient did not have hypoxemia requiring inpatient oxygen.

PNA-03 - Not met. Finding: Blood pressure was stable without need for resuscitation.

Overall rationale: The services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

No other criteria codes were applied in reaching this determination.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT INFORMATION

The following codes apply to the associated claim:

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

A reconsideration request may be submitted within the applicable filing window. Any clinical rationale submitted with the reconsideration request must map each finding to a numbered criterion as cited in this notice. Submissions that do not address the numbered criteria individually may be returned without substantive review.

Please note that level of care denials are not eligible for provider appeal.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that date will be closed as untimely.

Supporting documentation may include the complete medical record for the admission, physician progress notes, and any documentation relevant to the criteria cited above.

This determination addresses medical necessity only and does not alter member eligibility, benefit limitations, or other provisions of the member's plan documents. Payment remains subject to all applicable plan terms.

A copy of the criteria set applied is available upon request at no charge.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Northgate Advantage
